integrity: All statements were checked using the explicit complete Cartier matrix and two standalone exact-arithmetic programs; finite-field tests are corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: Classification is for coefficient-marked normalized family in characteristic five, not isomorphism classes or all Artin-Schreier genus-fourteen curves.
Existing 2020 paper establishes minimal a-number degree-eight examples and existence; novelty claim restricted to full two-parameter jump locus and Prym decomposition.
Unindexed priority overlap remains possible; no independent audit.
title: Two tangent jumping divisors in the a-number of a genus-fourteen Artin–Schreier family
